title: AWS Step Functions to Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 with Amazon RDS Data API transactions
description: An AWS Step Functions workflow runs a multi-statement SQL transaction on Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 through the Amazon RDS Data API and rolls it back on failure.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: An AWS Step Functions state machine opens a transaction with the Amazon RDS Data API, runs three SQL statements (insert an order, decrement stock with a guard, insert an audit row) with the same transaction id, and commits.

A statement error, or zero updated rows, calls RollbackTransaction and ends the execution in a Fail state, so none of the statements stay visible in the Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 database. No AWS Lambda function is in the request path.
